Nulls in raw merchant_id total 378, and batch 14 has 378 rows. So every row in batch 14 (the 2026-01-18 batch) has a NULL merchant_id. Of those, 363 are POSTED, which matches the alert. The upstream source stopped sending merchant_id for that batch.

The merchant_id cannot be recovered from the other columns. Customer and amount do not determine the merchant, and the dimension has no mapping from them. Filtering the rows out would silently drop real transactions, and imputing a merchant would corrupt the data. The batch needs to be re-delivered by the source team.

The reconciliation gap is 4630 − 4267 = 363, which is exactly the NULL rows being dropped by the inner join. This is a consequence of the same missing data, not a separate problem.

The decision is to escalate.
